tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. chA:A.41Let $\tilde{M}$ be a smooth manifold with or without boundary and let $M \subseteq \tilde{M}$ be an embedded submanifold with or without boundary. Show that a vector field $X \in \mathfrak {X}(\tilde{M})$ is tangent to $M$ if and only if $(Xf)|_M = 0$ whenever $f \in C^\infty (\tilde{M})$ is a function that vanishes on $M$. \end{exercise}
